entries.failure_mode: Demultiplexing/ambient tools dependent on mitochondrial genotype suffer silent bias due to genotype incompatibility when pooling humans-apes and other closely related species; genotype-based attribution fails.
entries.observable_signature: Bibliographic record: PMID:40166335 (CellBouncer unified toolkit reveals Hominid Mitochondrial Incompatibilities).
entries.mitigation: Check MT genotype compatibility before cross-species pooling (tool documentation + reference mitochondrial genome version); incompatible → switch to SNP/hashtag attribution; reuse preflight discipline from cross_species_panel_id_preflight for homologous lessons.

provenance.home_rationale: Species × tool interaction failure = condition-driven universal clause (not bound to dispute coordinates).
